thesis.core: Bank of China has a diversified systemically important banking franchise, a global cross-border settlement network and recurring net interest/fee income. H1 2026 earnings and credit metrics remain resilient. However ordinary-share ROE eased and CET1 fell 49bp despite adequate absolute capital; 2025 A-share issuance diluted per-share growth. At the 2026-10-29 A-share price, prospective price-only return fails the new-capital hurdle. Research conclusion is conditional BUY_BELOW, not an order.
thesis.variant_wedge: 2026H1 revenue RMB356.903bn +8.48%, attributable net profit RMB123.594bn +5.10%, deducted attributable RMB123.479bn, NIM 1.27% +1bp YoY, ROE 8.66% versus 9.11%, common EPS RMB0.36 unchanged, BVPS RMB8.54, NPL 1.22% versus 1.23%, coverage 200.85% versus 200.37%, CET1 12.04% versus 12.53% at 2025 year end. Asset impairment RMB68.076bn +18.39% YoY; risk-weighted assets expanded. At RMB7.16, P/B ~0.84x; the market already capitalizes much of the defensive bank franchise.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Common-share earnings normalized from 2026H1 EPS RMB0.36 (~RMB0.72 annualized cross-check) and BVPS RMB8.54, adjusted for ROE 8.66%, credit costs, capital dilution and deposit-rate repricing. Primary valuation is common P/B rather than industrial CFO/FCF. Analyst bear/base/bull multiples 0.60/0.78/0.96x; scenario-weighted RMB6.66/share, price-only expected return about -7.0%.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Large deposit franchise, NIM stabilization, NPL and provision metrics pass franchise/earnings quality gate. Yet ROE is below the assumed 10%-11% cost of equity, CET1 fell 49bp, impairment expenses rose 18.39% and per-share EPS did not rise. Reported bank operating cash flow is driven by financial intermediation, not cash distributable to ordinary shareholders. New capital fails price hurdle, especially given other bank exposure and near-term 2026Q3 report.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: 2026H1 attributable earnings are largely recurring but ordinary EPS remains RMB0.36 despite 5.10% reported attributable profit growth, following 2025 A-share issuance. Annualizing H1 common EPS is only a sensitivity, not forward guidance. Common BVPS RMB8.54 excludes other equity instruments. Bank CFO is distorted by deposit and loan flows and is not industrial free cash flow. PB 0.60/0.78/0.96x and scenario probabilities are analyst assumptions calibrated to ~8.66% ROE, 12.04% CET1, 1.22% NPL and expected credit-cost/interest-rate pressure; no 2026Q3 results are assumed.

catalysts: 2026Q3 results confirm recurring earnings and NIM stability without deterioration in credit cost or CET1.
Lower deposit funding costs continue to offset loan repricing, sustaining NIM near or above H1 1.27%.
Overseas and cross-border banking franchise generates profitable fee and settlement growth without undue FX or geopolitical credit losses.
Common-share payout is approved and funded by sustainable earnings and regulatory capital headroom, not incremental dilutive equity.
kill_thesis: CET1 declines materially below H1 12.04% without a credible organic rebuild, or ordinary shareholders face another dilutive capital raise.
NPL ratio materially exceeds H1 1.22% or coverage falls materially below H1 200.85% as real-estate, retail or overseas credit costs accelerate.
NIM falls materially below H1 1.27% and recurring common ROE drops below the modeled 8%-9% range without a credible offset.
Credit impairment growth outpaces recurring pre-provision income, constraining distributable common earnings or dividends.
Material geopolitical, foreign-exchange or overseas credit losses impair the international franchise.

evidence_gap.near_term_update: Issuer 2026Q3 report listed for 2026-10-31; not available at research cutoff 2026-10-30 09:30 CST. Material results require fresh D2.
